note: THE PRODUCT IMPORT LOOKUP DROPS AN ABOLISHED VERB. 145 -> 144: product.product._retrieve_product -> _get_imported_product, the one name in the retrieve family the gate could see. §2.4.11 keeps _resolve_ for a partial producer whose None routes somewhere; this one answers with an empty recordset like any other read, so _get_ is the canonical. The rest of the family carried the same spelling without being counted and moved with it -- _import_retrieve_product -> _get_product_from_search_plan, _import_retrieve_product_from_{barcode,default_code,name} -> _get_import_criteria_from_*, _get_retrieval_product_search_plan -> _get_import_product_search_plan, and the two sale_edi_ubl variants -- because §2.4.11 says rename the family or none of it. 8 call sites outside account: account_edi_ubl_cii, l10n_es_edi_facturae, sale_edi_ubl, enterprise/l10n_mx_edi and the agromarin/documents_l10n_mx_edi override. Measured in a detached worktree at HEAD with only this change's files copied in; the shared tree carries three other sessions' work.
